propositions: A duplication analyzer shells out to the jscpd CLI with a JSON reporter and parses statistics.total.clones (int) and statistics.total.percentage (float) into AnalyzerResult.duplication.
A single shared runner run_jscpd in _jscpd.py is used by both the new adapter and the backfill script to avoid invocation drift.
The jscpd invocation remains the bare binary command (no npx), keeping backfill behavior byte-for-byte unchanged.
When jscpd is absent (FileNotFoundError), analyze returns Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) rather than zeros or a raised error.
Nonzero or missing report data must not be silently converted into zero metrics.
